jewelry.name: lip-ornament
jewelry.title: lip-ornament
jewelry.reason: A carved walrus-ivory labret with a beaded dangle, explicitly attributed to the Chugach (Alutiiq) people, a traditional form of lip ornament worn by Alaskan coastal groups.

garment.name: hat
garment.title: hat
garment.reason: A twined spruce-root potlatch hat with formline painted design and potlatch rings, a classic Northwest Coast ceremonial/prestige headwear form consistent with Chugach/Alutiiq-area basketry hats.

garment.name: hat
garment.title: hat
garment.reason: This is a cone-shaped twined spruce-root hat with formline painted designs and glass bead trim, a well-documented type of ceremonial/hunting headgear made and worn by Chugach (Sugpiaq) and neighboring North Pacific coast peoples.

household.name: bowl
household.title: bowl
household.reason: A wooden seal-effigy bowl inlaid with shell/pyrite, a classic Chugach/Alutiiq hunting-oil bowl form; the museum attributes it directly to the Chugach, and the object type is characteristic Pacific Eskimo material culture.
